messages:
Jordan: Who wants to do a lunchtime 'stairs + mobility' micro-workout today? 20 minutes, meet by the north stairs at 12:30.
Casey: count me in. Ill bring a resistance band.
Anita: can we keep it low-impact? got a knee that sulks sometimes.
Jordan: absolutely  replacements: step-ups instead of box jumps, slow controlled tempo.
Luis: i'll join if there's a post-session 2k easy jog option.
Mira: ill do the mobility only but happy to cheer. any suggested stretches?
Jordan: short plan: 5min brisk stair climbs (easy pace), 8min mobility circuit (banded hip + thoracic rotations), 7min partner-assisted calf/ankle drills.
gymbot: Reminder: 'North stairs' reserved 12:15:45 today for wellness slot. Please don't block the bottom landing.
Casey: also bringing a small foam roller. Felix: I can bring one extra.
Felix: tempted to time the 2k as a friendly challenge, but only if we promise no podium pics. :sweat_smile:
Anita: deal. i'll take photos but will blur faces if people want.
Luis: nitro coffee available after? :coffee:
Mira: :coffee: for me. and can someone post the quick mobility routine in this thread so i can do it remote?
Jordan: will paste it after the session and add to the Wellness Google Doc. see you at 12:30!
Casey: RSVP in calendar. Jordan: thanks for organising.
Felix: packing ankle tape just in case.
gymbot: FYI: shared gear policy: return rollers and bands to 'Wellness Cupboard' after use.
